transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. Um... I guess I'm just here because... I feel like I can't really settle in my own body anymore. Especially if I'm supposed to just sit quietly and... handle paperwork, or go over shared household plans. It's just... yeah.
Did this difficulty sitting still and handling boring tasks also happen when you were a child?

Yeah... I guess so. Looking back, it was kind of already part of me in elementary school. Um... I was just the girl whose desk was always a mess. I'd forget permission slips a lot. And... well, my teachers would send notes home saying I talked out of turn, or... that I couldn't seem to stay in my seat. So... yeah.
Are these attention and restlessness problems causing significant trouble in your work or home life right now?

Um... yeah, I suppose so. It's... it's mostly that people at home, or even in the groups I volunteer with, they... they can't really depend on me. I've actually had to step back from some things recently. It's just... I try, but things keep falling through the cracks anyway. So... yeah, it causes some trouble.
